nodes.body_text: async def embed(self, contract_id: str, owner_id: str, chunks: Sequence[dict[str, Any]] | None = None) -> int: """Embed chunks off the event loop and atomically retain results before expiry.""" contract = await self.repository.get_contract(contract_id, owner_id) source = list(chunks) if chunks is not None else contract["chunks"] if not source: raise ValueError("Contract has no chunks to embed") deadline = await self.repository.get_contract_ttl(contract_id, owner_id) async with self._embedding_gate(): try: vectors = await asyncio.wait_for( asyncio.gather(*[asyncio.to_thread(self.embedding_service.embed_text, item["content"] if "content" in item else item["text"]) for item in source]), timeout=deadline, ) except TimeoutError as exc: raise ContractProcessingExpiredError("Contract expired during embedding") from exc embeddings = [] for chunk, vector in zip(source, vectors): normalized = self._validate_vector(vector) embeddings.append({"chunk_id": chunk.get("chunk_id", str(chunk.get("chunk_index", len(embeddings)))), "chunk_index": chunk.get("chunk_index", len(embeddings)), "vector": normalized}) def apply(updated: dict[str, Any]) -> None: if chunks is not None: updated["chunks"] = list(chunks) updated["embeddings"] = embeddings await self.repository.update_contract(contract_id, owner_id, apply) return len(embeddings)

nodes.body_text: async def search(self, contract_id: str, owner_id: str, query: str, top_k: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]: """Search one contract's in-memory vectors using vectorized cosine similarity.""" contract = await self.repository.get_contract(contract_id, owner_id) if not contract["embeddings"]: return [] deadline = await self.repository.get_contract_ttl(contract_id, owner_id) try: query_vector = await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(self.embedding_service.embed_text, query), timeout=deadline) result = await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(self._rank, contract, query_vector, top_k), timeout=deadline) except TimeoutError as exc: raise ContractProcessingExpiredError("Contract expired during search") from exc await self.repository.get_contract_ttl(contract_id, owner_id) return result

nodes.name: _validate_vector
nodes.body_text: def _validate_vector(vector: Sequence[float]) -> list[float]: """Normalize and validate a single embedding vector.""" array = np.asarray(vector, dtype=np.float32) if array.shape != (384,) or not np.isfinite(array).all() or float(np.linalg.norm(array)) == 0: raise InvalidEmbeddingError("Expected a finite non-zero 384-dimensional embedding") return array.tolist()

nodes.name: _rank
nodes.signature: def _rank(cls, contract: dict[str, Any], query_vector: Sequence[float], top_k: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]
nodes.body_text: def _rank(cls, contract: dict[str, Any], query_vector: Sequence[float], top_k: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]: """Return top matching chunks after validating query and stored vector shapes.""" query = np.asarray(cls._validate_vector(query_vector), dtype=np.float32) rows = contract["embeddings"] matrix = np.asarray([row["vector"] for row in rows], dtype=np.float32) if matrix.ndim != 2 or matrix.shape[1] != 384 or not np.isfinite(matrix).all(): raise InvalidEmbeddingError("Stored embeddings are invalid") norms = np.linalg.norm(matrix, axis=1) * np.linalg.norm(query) if np.any(norms == 0): raise InvalidEmbeddingError("Stored embeddings contain a zero vector") scores = matrix @ query / norms chunks = {str(chunk.get("chunk_id", chunk.get("chunk_index"))): chunk for chunk in contract["chunks"]} ordered = np.argsort(-scores)[:top_k] return [{"contract_id": contract["contract_id"], "chunk_id": rows[index]["chunk_id"], "content": chunks.get(str(rows[index]["chunk_id"]), {}).get("content", ""), "similarity": float(scores[index])} for index in ordered]

nodes.body_text: def _correct_group(title: str, group: list[dict], candidates: dict, corrections: list[dict]) -> None: if not ARTICLE.match(title): return expected = _article_number(title) numbered = [(item, match) for item in group if (match := PREFIX.match(item["text"]))] if len(numbered) < 2: return first, second = numbered[0][1], numbered[1][1] # Infer a misread zero only from a 0,2 sequence in the same article. if first.group(1) != "0" or second.group(1) != "2" or first.group(3) != second.group(3): return raw = first.group(3) expected_text = str(expected) if expected is not None else None article_fix = (expected_text and raw != expected_text and raw == expected_text.replace("1", "0") and "1" in expected_text) if not expected_text or (raw != expected_text and not article_fix): return if article_fix: candidates[raw].add(expected_text) for item, match in numbered: if match.group(3) != raw: continue ordinal = "1" if item is numbered[0][0] else match.group(1) replacement = ordinal + "-" + (expected_text if article_fix else raw) _record_correction(item, replacement + item["text"][match.end():], match.group(0), replacement, corrections)

field.clear(); value.clear() def headers_finished(): disposition, params = parse_options_header(headers.get(b"content-disposition", b"")) if disposition != b"form-data" or params.get(b"name") != b"file" or b"filename" not in params: raise HTTPException(422, "Exactly one file is required") def part_data(data, start, end): if len(content) + end - start > maximum: raise HTTPException(413, "File too large") content.extend(data[start:end]) def finished(): state["complete"] = True parser = MultipartParser(options[b"boundary"], {"on_part_begin": part_begin, "on_header_field": header_field, "on_header_value": header_value, "on_header_end": header_end, "on_headers_finished": headers_finished, "on_part_data": part_data, "on_end": finished}) try: received = 0 async for chunk in request.stream(): received += len(chunk) if received > maximum + 16384: raise HTTPException(413, "Request too large") parser.write(chunk) parser.finalize() if not state["complete"] or state["parts"] != 1 or not content: raise HTTPException(422, "Incomplete or empty file") kind = FORMATS.get(headers.get(b"content-type", b"").lower()) if kind is None: raise HTTPException(415, "Only PDF and DOCX files are supported") result = await asyncio.to_thread(extract_document, bytes(content), kind) clauses = [ClauseInput.model_validate({key: item[key] for key in ("clause_id", "index", "article_title", "text")}) for item in result["clauses"]] classifications = await HybridClauseClassifier(LLMTaxonomyGateway(), Settings().taxonomy_llm_concurrency).classify_batch(clauses) for item, classification in zip(result["clauses"], classifications): item["taxonomy"] = classification.model_dump(mode="json") item["search_context"] = search_context(item["article_title"], classification.primary_category, item["text"]) return result except MultipartParseError as exc: raise HTTPException(422, "Invalid multipart body") from exc finally: content.clear()

0-0 طراحی سامانه
2-0 تحویل سامانه
